verdict.rationale: Muse is built around delegating tasks to an in-app AI agent that has its own computer/terminal, can build tools it lacks, tracks tasks in a Goals tab, and lets users interact via chat or side chats — a clear built-in assistant delegation model. Community evidence corroborates the agentic architecture exists (control plane, tool-building) though notes stress limits under load. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of task delegation reliability at scale, and clearer detail on the range/complexity of tasks it can autonomously complete beyond tool-building.
